keyframes.source: 1. Baker folds the dough over itself.
keyframes.state: The dough rests folded over itself on the workbench in front of baker.

keyframes.source: 2. Baker presses the dough away from us with both palms.
keyframes.state: The folded dough is compressed farther from the camera on the worktop, beneath both of baker’s palms.

keyframes.source: 3. Baker shapes the dough into a loaf.
keyframes.state: The dough is now a broad, oval, unbaked loaf with rounded ends, resting on the workbench in front of baker.

keyframes.source: 5. Baker opens the oven to the left of the workbench.
keyframes.state: The oven door is open to the left of the workbench. The unbaked loaf remains on the worktop.

keyframes.source: 6. Baker lifts the loaf from the workbench.
keyframes.state: Baker holds the unbaked loaf clear of the workbench; its former place on the worktop is empty.

keyframes.source: 7. Baker moves left and slides the loaf into the oven.
keyframes.state: Baker is now left of the workbench, in front of the open oven. The unbaked loaf rests inside the oven, and baker’s hands are empty.

keyframes.source: 8. Baker lifts the pastry tray from beside the flour bowl.
keyframes.state: Baker holds the pastry tray with all six unbaked croissants still on it. The space beside the flour bowl is empty.

keyframes.source: 9. Baker slides the tray into the oven, away from us.
keyframes.state: The pastry tray rests inside the open oven, farther from the camera, with all six croissants on it; the loaf remains inside as well. Baker stands at the oven with empty hands.
The oven door is closed, concealing the loaf and the pastry tray with its six croissants inside. Baker remains in front of the oven.

first: Live-action wide view from a fixed, eye-height camera in the rear customer-side corner of a modest working bakery, looking diagonally toward the front wall. Cream plaster, honey-coloured timber, worn stone flooring and dark metal baking equipment give the clean, comfortably used room a warm, handmade character. The blue glazed shop door is far left, with its shop-name sign mounted at adult chest height; the large clear front window is far right. The wooden shop counter occupies middle left and runs from near to far. Along the visible right wall, the wire cooling rack is near right, the closed baking oven is middle right, and the wooden workbench is far right with its working edge toward the camera. Baker, the only character present, stands at the workbench facing the worktop. One plump, pale-cream ball of dough with a slightly flattened base rests on the worktop in front of baker. The flour bowl rests at the far-right end of the worktop; beside it rests one shallow charcoal-grey metal pastry tray with rounded corners and a narrow raised rim, holding six plump, pale butter-yellow unbaked croissants.
